title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
source: flac24/96 Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info:WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master Reel Transferred by Rob Eaton; All Mastering By Charlie Miller; the original version of this source had a 2 second dropout in thrack 16 (Playing In The Band)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑1973 show with a killer Nobody’s Fault But Mine jam after Truckin’ and standout renditions of Stella Blue, Half‑Step and He’s Gone.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a pristine soundboard mix – “fantastic” and “excellent” quality – giving listeners crystal‑clear access to the band’s early‑73 vibe.  Musically the show shines with a sweet Nobody's Fault But Mine jam trailing Truckin', superb takes of Stella Blue, Half‑Step, He's Gone (and a memorable Stella > Jack transition), delivering an overall “mighty fine” performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Four of five reviews are 4‑5 stars and specifically praise both the performance (standout jams, strong song selections) and the soundboard recording; only one outlier gives a zero rating unrelated to music quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the mix 'fantastic', 'crisp' and 'excellent'; no drop‑outs or balance issues are mentioned. Recorded by Charlie with a clean, full‑range sound.

standout_songs: Truckin' > Nobody's Fault But Mine jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑73 energy noted as a 'nice ride on the Mississippi'; transitions such as Stella > Jack are highlighted, indicating smooth pacing and strong set construction.
